title: The Locked Ledger
description: A banker vanished after his vault showed impossible numbers. Follow the timeline before the trail goes cold.
intro: The Whitmore Trust vault was opened at 2 AM—by someone who should have been miles away.

clue-1.title: Incident Report
clue-1.content: Vault opened 2:14 AM. £20,000 missing. Security log shows only one key used—assigned to clerk Horace Bell.

clue-2.title: Suspect: Margaret Ashford
clue-2.content: Senior accountant. Claims she left the building at 6 PM. Her coat was still on her chair at 8 PM per the night guard.

clue-3.title: Altered Ledger Page
clue-3.content: Page 47 shows withdrawals re-dated. Ink is fresh; the bank closed at 5 PM. Someone worked after hours.

clue-4.title: Timeline Gap
clue-4.content: Margaret's coat at 8 PM contradicts her 6 PM exit. She was in the building when the ledger was altered.

clue-5.title: Railway Manifest
clue-5.content: A ticket to Dover was purchased at 2:40 AM under the name 'H. Bell'—but Horace Bell was hospitalized since noon.

clue-6.title: Forged Identity
clue-6.content: Margaret used Bell's name at the station while Bell had an alibi. She had vault access and motive to embezzle.

combinations.message: Fresh ink means the books were cooked after closing.

challenge.prompt: Who could have altered the ledger?

options.text: Someone still in the building after 6 PM
Horace Bell from his hospital bed
A random burglar with no key

combinations.message: The false name ties the accountant to the escape route.

challenge.prompt: What proves Margaret is the thief?

options.text: She was present after hours and used Bell's name on the manifest
Bell's key was stolen by an unknown party
The night guard opened the vault

suspects.name: Margaret Ashford
suspects.detail: Coat left behind; access to ledgers and vault procedures.

suspects.name: Horace Bell
suspects.detail: Key holder, but hospitalized before the theft.

suspects.name: Silas Croft
suspects.detail: Logged Margaret's coat at 8 PM. Denies entering the vault.

solution.explanation: Margaret Ashford stayed after hours, altered the ledger, stole £20,000, and fled using Horace Bell's name while he was hospitalized.
solution.redHerringNote: Horace held the vault key, but hospital records place him away from the bank when the theft occurred.
